inventory_kind: complete Cargo.lock registry-package superset with original upstream licensing files

scope.included: Every registry package in the pinned device/Cargo.lock, including build dependencies, proc-macro dependencies and target-conditional packages. All copied files are original bytes extracted from SHA256-verified crate archives.
scope.classification_method: Conservative role classification from the first-party Cargo.toml and exact published dependency declarations; not a cargo build, target-resolved SBOM or binary-link audit. Manifest declarations can include optional, dev, and always-false cfg edges; their presence here does not assert activation.
scope.actual_linked_target_set_status: Not determined. Retaining the whole lockfile notice superset is deliberate. Target/features/build evidence is required before narrowing it.
excluded_from_this_inventory: Rust toolchain and standard-library distribution notices
Operating-system, C runtime and other system-library notices
GPUIX native addon and JavaScript packages
Dependencies declared in upstream manifests but absent from the pinned worker Cargo.lock

license_selection_policy: Elect MIT where MIT is an available permissive branch; elect BSL-1.0 for ryu. Unicode-3.0 remains required in addition to the elected MIT branch for unicode-ident. All shipped alternative upstream license texts are retained, including those for unelected branches.
file_collection_method: Case-insensitive archive filename scan for license/licence, COPYING, copyright, NOTICE and AUTHORS; preserve all matches. Also preserve upstream Cargo manifests, VCS metadata, README license context, and complete Rust/C source files containing copyright or SPDX notices. No line-ending, encoding or text modifications.
